svg.text: The period-3 clock is load-bearing for donor-acceptor routing
Each comb head reads one codon position
Only the carrier's own band matters
Carrier fully deleted at the left edge
L1H12 a comb, not in the circuit

Panel C is the dose run (n = 256): coupling 0.946 -> 0.026. Panel D is the mediation run (n = 160), with its own baseline 0.943 -> 0.034; percentages are of THAT lost coupling. Each restoration is scored only against random head sets OF ITS OWN SIZE (exact add-one p, 24 matched nulls).
